title: CR-BRK-014 — Settings sub-setting ON but Settings parent OFF — parent-gate bypass
preconds: Settings \u2717 | (App Settings / Finance / Wages set ON underneath) | WO V \u2713 | View Mode: Full (View Mode as specified).
steps:
1. Configure a custom role per the Setup in Preconditions; assign to a test user and log in.
  2. Confirm Administration nav hidden; attempt direct URL to a settings sub-section.
expected:
Administration nav hidden; all sub-settings inaccessible (§3 OFF). Sub-settings are hidden in the editor.

Risk / Rationale: A settings sub-section reachable via URL despite the Settings parent being OFF.
Spec Ref: §3 Settings
